title: Symptom Flare vs Glucose Variance
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:symptom symptom_family=* glucose_variance=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(glucose_variance) as metric by _time symptom_family
| sort 0 _time symptom_family
description: Trends monthly glucose variance by symptom family for flare tracking.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether flare tracking are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `symptom_family` on `health:symptom` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly glucose variance.
visualization: Line chart of monthly glucose variance by symptom family.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how glucose variance changes month by month for each symptom family so you can see whether flare tracking are heading the right way.
